Private Room in a Victorian Townhouse – Quillfield

A calm, private bedroom on the second floor of our Victorian townhouse in the Quillfield arts district. You get your own bathroom across the hall and a desk by the bay window. We (two teachers and a very polite greyhound) live downstairs.

Room features
- Private bathroom
- Desk and ergonomic chair
- Wi-Fi
- Mini fridge and kettle

Please note
- Shoes off inside, please
- No guests of guests
- Quiet after 10 PM on weekdays

Guests: 2
Check-in from 6 PM
Check-out by 12 PM
